component.name: Chromiator
component.summary: Partition and remap perceptual color spaces

description.p: Chromiator is an artist-directed color remapping application. Editable Voronoi sites simplify, segment, recolor, and blend an image's color structure while preserving its spatial structure.
Adjust independent source and target colors, choose matching and blending spaces, and explore built-in or personal presets.
